title: 🗄️ How to Design an E-Commerce Database?
excerpt: How should we organize the data? 🤔
body:
ㅤ
📘 Engineering Notes | From Concepts to Code — Post 06
ㅤ
Imagine building an e-commerce application where customers browse products and place orders.

How should we organize the data? 🤔

Storing everything in one table creates duplication and makes maintenance difficult.

That's where relational database design helps!

Let's break it down. 👇
ㅤ
1️⃣ 𝗜𝗱𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗶𝗳𝘆 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗠𝗮𝗶𝗻 𝗧𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲𝘀 📋

A basic e-commerce database contains:

👤 Customers — Customer information
📦 Products — Product details
🛒 Orders — Customer orders
🧾 Order_Items — Products in each order
💳 Payments — Payment details

Each table has a specific responsibility.
ㅤ
2️⃣ 𝗨𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗿𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗣𝗿𝗶𝗺𝗮𝗿𝘆 𝗞𝗲𝘆𝘀 🔑

A Primary Key (PK) uniquely identifies a record.

Customers
• customer_id (PK)
• name
• email

Products
• product_id (PK)
• name
• price
ㅤ
3️⃣ 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝗻𝗲𝗰𝘁 𝗧𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲𝘀 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗙𝗼𝗿𝗲𝗶𝗴𝗻 𝗞𝗲𝘆𝘀 🔗

A Foreign Key (FK) connects tables and maintains referential integrity.

Orders
• order_id (PK)
• customer_id (FK)
• order_date

Here, customer_id references Customers.

This connects each order to its customer.
ㅤ
4️⃣ 𝗛𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗹𝗲 𝗠𝗮𝗻𝘆-𝘁𝗼-𝗠𝗮𝗻𝘆 𝗥𝗲𝗹𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽𝘀 🔄

An order can contain multiple products, and a product can appear in many orders.

We use an Order_Items table:

• order_item_id (PK)
• order_id (FK)
• product_id (FK)
• quantity
• unit_price

This connects Orders and Products without duplicating product details.
ㅤ
5️⃣ 𝗧𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝗥𝗲𝗹𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽𝘀 🧩

✅ One Customer → Many Orders

✅ One Order → Many Order Items

✅ One Product → Many Order Items

✅ One Order → Multiple Payments (if supported)

These relationships keep data organized and consistent.
ㅤ
6️⃣ 𝗪𝗵𝘆 𝗚𝗼𝗼𝗱 𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮𝗯𝗮𝘀𝗲 𝗗𝗲𝘀𝗶𝗴𝗻 𝗠𝗮𝘁𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘀 ⚙️

✅ Reduces data duplication
✅ Maintains data integrity
✅ Simplifies maintenance
✅ Supports efficient queries
✅ Makes future development easier
ㅤ
💡 𝗠𝘆 𝗞𝗲𝘆 𝗧𝗮𝗸𝗲𝗮𝘄𝗮𝘆

Good database design isn't just about creating tables.

It's about understanding relationships and organizing data around business requirements.

A strong database structure helps build reliable and maintainable applications.
